title: Jobs in My Family

scenes.t: {name} talks about jobs. My aunt works as a doctor. She helps patients.
My father is a teacher. He works at a school.
My uncle bakes delicious bread. He is a baker.
My mother is a pilot. She travels around the world.
My grandfather is a farmer. He grows vegetables.
What do you want to be when you grow up? I want to be a doctor!

items.a: Flies a plane around the world.

He wants to be a doctor.
